import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, itertools, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, dendrogram
from scipy.spatial.distance import squareform
raw="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=[l.split() for l in raw.split("\n")];al=ls[0];BL={}
for r_ in ls[1:]:
    for b,v in zip(al,r_[1:]): BL[(r_[0],b)]=int(v)
def nw(s1,s2,go=11,ge=1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-10**9
    M=[[NEG]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)];Ix=[r[:] for r in M];Iy=[r[:] for r in M]
    pM=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)];pIx=[r[:] for r in pM];pIy=[r[:] for r in pM]
    M[0][0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i][0]=-go-ge*(i-1);pIx[i][0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0][j]=-go-ge*(j-1);pIy[0][j]=2
    Sr=[[BL.get((a,b),-2) for b in s2] for a in s1]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mp,Ixp,Iyp=M[i-1],Ix[i-1],Iy[i-1];Mi,Ixi,Iyi=M[i],Ix[i],Iy[i]
        Si=Sr[i-1];pMi,pIxi,pIyi=pM[i],pIx[i],pIy[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a,b,c=Mp[j-1],Ixp[j-1],Iyp[j-1]
            if a>=b and a>=c: Mi[j]=a+Si[j-1];pMi[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Mi[j]=b+Si[j-1];pMi[j]=1
            else: Mi[j]=c+Si[j-1];pMi[j]=2
            a,b,c=Mp[j]-go,Ixp[j]-ge,Iyp[j]-go
            if a>=b and a>=c: Ixi[j]=a;pIxi[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Ixi[j]=b;pIxi[j]=1
            else: Ixi[j]=c;pIxi[j]=2
            a,b,c=Mi[j-1]-go,Ixi[j-1]-go,Iyi[j-1]-ge
            if a>=b and a>=c: Iyi[j]=a;pIyi[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Iyi[j]=b;pIyi[j]=1
            else: Iyi[j]=c;pIyi[j]=2
    st=int(np.argmax([M[n][m],Ix[n][m],Iy[n][m]]));i,j=n,m;A=[];C=[];P=[pM,pIx,pIy]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: A.append("-");C.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);C.append("-");i-=1;continue
        if st==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);C.append(s2[j-1]);ns=P[0][i][j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);C.append("-");ns=P[1][i][j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: A.append("-");C.append(s2[j-1]);ns=P[2][i][j];j-=1;st=ns
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(C))
def up(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
S={g:up(a) for g,a in [("Aad3","P25612"),("Aad4","Q07747"),("Aad6","P43547"),("Aad10","P47182"),
                       ("Aad14","P42884"),("Aad15","Q08361"),("Ypl088w","Q02895")]}
S["Aad16"]=requests.get("https://www.yeastgenome.org/backend/locus/YFL057C/sequence_details",timeout=60).json()["protein"][0]["residues"].rstrip("*")
names=["Aad14","Aad4","Aad10","Aad6","Aad3","Aad15","Aad16","Ypl088w"]
pid=pd.DataFrame(np.nan,index=names,columns=names); ovl=pid.copy()
for g1,g2 in itertools.combinations(names,2):
    a,b=nw(S[g1],S[g2]); m=[(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b) if x!="-" and y!="-"]
    v=100*sum(x==y for x,y in m)/len(m)
    pid.loc[g1,g2]=pid.loc[g2,g1]=v; ovl.loc[g1,g2]=ovl.loc[g2,g1]=len(m)
for g in names: pid.loc[g,g]=100.0; ovl.loc[g,g]=len(S[g])
print("Pairwise % identity (ungapped overlap):"); print(pid.round(1).to_string())
print("\nOverlap length (aa):"); print(ovl.round(0).astype(int).to_string())
pid.to_csv("aad_pairwise_identity.csv")

# NJ
cur=list(names); Dcur=(100-pid.loc[names,names].values)/100.0; nk={n:n for n in cur}
while len(cur)>2:
    n=len(cur); Rr=Dcur.sum(1); Q=np.full((n,n),np.inf)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i!=j: Q[i,j]=(n-2)*Dcur[i,j]-Rr[i]-Rr[j]
    i,j=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(Q),Q.shape); i,j=min(i,j),max(i,j)
    di=0.5*Dcur[i,j]+(Rr[i]-Rr[j])/(2*(n-2)); dj=Dcur[i,j]-di
    node=f"({nk[cur[i]]}:{max(di,0):.4f},{nk[cur[j]]}:{max(dj,0):.4f})"
    keep=[k for k in range(n) if k not in (i,j)]
    nl=[cur[k] for k in keep]+[f"N{n}"]
    nd=np.zeros((n-1,n-1))
    for a_,ka in enumerate(keep):
        for b_,kb in enumerate(keep): nd[a_,b_]=Dcur[ka,kb]
    for a_,ka in enumerate(keep):
        nd[a_,-1]=nd[-1,a_]=0.5*(Dcur[ka,i]+Dcur[ka,j]-Dcur[i,j])
    nk={**{cur[k]:nk[cur[k]] for k in keep}, nl[-1]:node}; cur=nl; Dcur=nd
nwk=f"({nk[cur[0]]}:{Dcur[0,1]/2:.4f},{nk[cur[1]]}:{Dcur[0,1]/2:.4f});"
print("\nNJ Newick (protein p-distance):\n",nwk)
open("aad_nj_tree.nwk","w").write(nwk)

# ---- figure ----
telo=pd.DataFrame([("AAD3","YCR107W","III",313890,314981,316620),("AAD15","YOL165C","XV",1647,2078,1091291),
 ("AAD16","YFL057C","VI",14305,14763,270161),("AAD6","YFL056C","VI",14305,15431,270161),
 ("AAD14","YNL331C","XIV",16118,17248,784333),("AAD10","YJR155W","X",727405,728271,745751),
 ("AAD4","YDL243C","IV",17577,18566,1531933),("YPL088W","YPL088W","XVI",381965,382993,948066)],
 columns=["gene","orf","chrom","start","end","chrlen"])
telo["dist_kb"]=telo.apply(lambda r: min(r.start, r.chrlen-r.end)/1000.0,axis=1)
telo=telo.sort_values("dist_kb")
telo.to_csv("aad_telomere_distance.csv",index=False)

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,9))
ax1=plt.subplot2grid((2,3),(0,0),colspan=1)
c=["#c44"]*len(telo); c[list(telo.gene).index("YPL088W")]="#888"
ax1.barh(telo.gene,telo.dist_kb,color=c)
ax1.set_xscale("log"); ax1.axvline(20,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax1.set_xlabel("distance to nearest chromosome end (kb, log scale)")
ax1.set_title("All seven AAD loci lie within 20 kb of a telomere\n(YPL088W, 382 kb, does not)",fontsize=10)

ax2=plt.subplot2grid((2,3),(0,1),colspan=2)
im=ax2.imshow(pid.loc[names,names].values.astype(float),cmap="viridis",vmin=20,vmax=100)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(names)));ax2.set_xticklabels(names,rotation=45,ha="right")
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(names)));ax2.set_yticklabels(names)
for i in range(len(names)):
    for j in range(len(names)):
        ax2.text(j,i,f"{pid.iloc[i,j]:.0f}",ha="center",va="center",
                 color="w" if pid.iloc[i,j]<70 else "k",fontsize=8)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax2,label="% identity")
ax2.set_title("Pairwise amino-acid identity over the aligned overlap",fontsize=10)

ax3=plt.subplot2grid((2,3),(1,0),colspan=1)
dm=squareform((100-pid.loc[names,names].values.astype(float))/100.0,checks=False)
Z=linkage(dm,method="average")
dendrogram(Z,labels=names,ax=ax3,orientation="left",color_threshold=0.35)
ax3.set_xlabel("p-distance"); ax3.set_title("UPGMA clustering of Aad proteins",fontsize=10)

ax4=plt.subplot2grid((2,3),(1,1),colspan=2); ax4.axis("off")
tet={"Aad14":["D","Y","K","H"],"Aad4":["D","Y","K","H"],"Aad10":["-","-","K","H"],
     "Aad6":["D","Y","K","H"],"Aad3":["D","C","K","H"],"Aad15":["-","-","-","-"],
     "Aad16":["-","-","-","-"],"Ypl088w":["D","Y","K","H"]}
cols=["Asp71","Tyr76","Lys103","His151"]
tbl=[[g]+tet[g] for g in names]
t=ax4.table(cellText=tbl,colLabels=["protein"]+cols,loc="center",cellLoc="center")
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(10); t.scale(1,1.6)
for r_ in range(1,len(names)+1):
    g=names[r_-1]
    for c_ in range(1,5):
        v=tet[g][c_-1]
        if v=="-": t[(r_,c_)].set_facecolor("#dddddd")
        elif g=="Aad3" and cols[c_-1]=="Tyr76": t[(r_,c_)].set_facecolor("#e86b6b")
        else: t[(r_,c_)].set_facecolor("#9ecf9e")
ax4.set_title("Aldo-keto reductase catalytic tetrad (Aad14 alignment coordinates).\n"
              "Aad3 carries a unique Tyr76Cys change (Tyr73 in Aad3 numbering); grey = region absent from the protein",
              fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(telo.to_string(index=False))
